mapper.select: /** slave-personincharge-mapper.getLocgovList (하위 지자체 조회) */ SELECT L.LOCGOV_CODE, L.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM, L.LOCGOV_NM, L.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE, L.LOCGOV_INTRCN_CN, crypto_dec('normal', L.CHARGER_CTTPC, '', 0) AS CHARGER_CTTPC, crypto_dec('normal', L.CHARGER_NM, '', 0) AS CHARGER_NM, L.CHARGER_PSITN_DEPT, L.LOCGOV_HMPG, L.LOCGOV_POPLTN_CO, L.LOCGOV_AR, L.LOCGOV_SPCPRD, L.GCCT_USE_AT, L.ETRCSH_USE_AT, L.USE_AT, L.LOCGOV_BUDGET_AMT, L.BIZRNO, L.LOCGOV_ZIP, L.BASS_ADRES, L.DTL_ADRES, L.ACHLQR_SLE_AT, L.FRST_REGISTER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(L.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'%Y-%m-%d') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, L.LAST_UPDUSR_ID, DATE_FORMAT(L.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM,'%Y-%m-%d') AS LAST_UPDT_PNTTM FROM G_LOCGOV L WHERE L.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE = #{upperLocgovCode} AND L.USE_AT = 'Y' ORDER BY L.ORDERING

/** slave-personincharge-mapper.getLocgovMainPersonInChargeCount (지자체 주담당자 인원수 확인) */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OP_MANAGER M INNER JOIN OP_USER_ROLE R ON M.USER_ID = R.USER_ID AND R.AUTHORITY = 'ROLE_ADMIN_5' WHERE M.LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCode} AND M.STATUS_CODE IN (9, 2) AND M.USER_ID != #{userId}

/** slave-personincharge-mapper.getGovMainPersonInChargeCount (행안부 주담당자 인원수 확인) */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OP_MANAGER M INNER JOIN OP_USER_ROLE R ON M.USER_ID = R.USER_ID AND R.AUTHORITY = 'ROLE_ADMIN_3' WHERE M.STATUS_CODE IN (9, 2) AND M.USER_ID != #{userId}
